title: Figure 26: Schematic of biodegradable (bioerodible) drug delivery device
description: Schematic showing a large orange sphere labeled "polymer" with embedded dots labeled "drug" at "time - 0", and an arrow to a smaller sphere releasing dots at "time - t". Caption: "Figure 26. Schematic Representation of Biodegradable (Bioerodible) Drug Delivery Device." The text lists localized delivery, sustained delivery and drug stabilization as key advantages.
